defs.def: a piece of furniture like a table, usually with drawers in it, that you sit at to read, write, work, etc. 书桌；写字台；办公桌

ex.s: “If I were to bring my clay here and work for three hours every afternoon, I could complete most of the project while you are at your desk. ”
ex.t: 她的声音轻柔但自信，同时指向窗户附近的角落。

ex.s: Bechtel，who works in downtown West Palm Beach，has lunch with coworkers sometimes，but like many of us，too often works through lunch at her desk.
ex.t: 贝克特尔在西棕榈滩市中心工作，有时会和同事一起吃午餐，但像我们许多人一样，她也经常在办公桌前边工作边吃午餐。

ex.s: He is most probably jumping from the desk.
ex.t: 如果这位女士参加面试，她很难得到这份工作。

ex.s: He is most probably repairing the desk.
ex.t: 如果这位女士参加面试，她可以得到这份工作。

ex.s: He kept it hidden in a drawer in his desk.
ex.t: 他把它藏在书桌的一个抽屉里。

ex.s: My parents soon worked out this trick, though, and one day I came home to find that my room 3___________ (clean), and my homework 4___________ (put) right in the centre of a spotlessly clean desk!
ex.t: 不过，我父母很快识破了这个伎俩，有一天我回到家，发现我的房间 3___________（被打扫干净了），我的作业 4___________（被放）在一尘不染的书桌正中央！

ex.s: A present 5___________ (leave) on the desk, too (I think Mum did that): a book called The Art of Procrastination.
ex.t: 一份礼物 5___________（被留）在书桌上（我想是妈妈放的）：一本叫《拖延的艺术》的书。

defs.def: a place where you can get information or be served at an airport, a hotel, etc. （机场、旅馆等的）问讯台，服务台，工作台

ex.s: The lockers are located in Building 1 near the Information Desk and in Building 3.
Pushchairs and wheelchairs are available to rent at the Information Desk and Denny Way entrance.
ex.t: 文本最后一部分的目的是什么？

ex.s: At the information desk at the entrance, I asked a lady where the shoe section was.
ex.t: 在入口处的咨询台，我问一位女士鞋区在哪里。

defs.def: an office at a newspaper, television company, etc. that deals with a particular subject （报社、电视台等的）办公处，部，室，组

ex.s: The young banker who eats lunch at his desk is probably seen as a go-getter, while his colleagues who chat over a relaxed conference-room meal get dirty looks from the corner office.
ex.t: 在办公桌前吃午饭的年轻银行家可能被视为积极进取的人，而在轻松的会议室用餐聊天的同事却会受到角落办公室的白眼。

ex.s: I would go to the office, sit at my desk and repeat the same work five days a week 9 to 5.
ex.t: 我去上班坐在办公桌前每周五天朝九晚五重复同样的工作。
